paragraphs: iSport360 sells a youth sports platform that its home page sets apart from player registration software, describing the product as focused on team development and culture. The platform runs player evaluations and player self evals, deploys ongoing feedback and sticker rewards, and sets goals the page says are in line with the sports National Governing Bodies. A Virtual Team Locker Room lets players share, chat and connect in what the page calls an environment compliant with SafeSport and COPPA child privacy laws.

The pages name club admins, coaches, players and parents as the groups that use the platform, telling club admins it helps retain players by improving communication, player development and team culture. Coaches are given tools and best practices, and can extend training beyond the field, the court and the ice with training videos and practice assignments. An item on the about page reports that Washington Youth Soccer and iSport360 agreed on a partnership to help every soccer player, coach and parent.

quote.text: The only youth sports platform to help keep your teams organized, improving and engaged.
